Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are learning long and short.
Look. Here is a rope, and here is a pencil.
The rope is long. The pencil is short.
Now here are two snakes. Which one is longer?
The blue snake, I think. It reaches further that way.
Wait. They do not start in the same place.
Let us slide them back. Both tails on the red line.
Now look again. The green snake is longer.
To find out which is longer, always start at the same line.
Here are three long things, all starting at the red line.
A rope, a sugarcane, and a line of ants.
The ants go the furthest. The line of ants is the longest.
The sugarcane stops first. The sugarcane is the shortest.
So, long goes far. Short does not go far.
And to compare, line them up at the same start.
Well done, my friend! Now go and find long and short things at home.
A spoon and a broom. A pencil and a rope. Line them up and look.
